title: Building words: prefixes and suffixes
title_target: Jag tror att jag har knäckt koden!
goal: Take Swedish words apart and guess their meaning from the pieces — the fastest way to grow your vocabulary at B2.
bekal: reading a Swedish job ad and decoding its long words
wave: Go back to Unit 7: list ten nouns in *-ning*, *-else*, *-het* and *-ande* from its dialogues and split each one into stem + suffix (*förtät + ning*, *betyd + else*). Today you add six prefixes and five more suffixes to the same toolbox.

dialogs.title: Dialogue — Ordleken
dialogs.intro: Dian has just sent the complete draft of her thesis to Birgitta. Elin wants to celebrate — in her own way, which, being a librarian, involves words. They sit in the library café after closing time.

lines.speaker: Elin:
lines.text: Grattis till det färdiga utkastet! Nu firar vi med en ordlek: jag säger ett ord, du gissar vad det betyder. ”Ohållbar.”
lines.id: Congratulations on finishing your draft! Now we celebrate with a word game: I say a word, you guess what it means. "Ohållbar."
lines.literal: congrats to the finished draft-the! now celebrate we with a word-game: I say a word, you guess what it means. un-hold-able

lines.speaker: Dian:
lines.text: Lätt. ”O-” betyder ”inte”, så det är något som inte är hållbart. Min specialitet!
lines.id: Easy. "O-" means "not", so it's something that isn't sustainable. My specialty!
lines.literal: easy. o- means not, so it is something that not is sustainable. my specialty!

lines.speaker: Elin:
lines.text: Rätt. ”Missförstånd”?
lines.id: Right. "Missförstånd"?
lines.literal: right. mis-understanding?

lines.speaker: Dian:
lines.text: ”Miss-” betyder att något går fel… så man har förstått fel?
lines.id: "Miss-" means something goes wrong… so someone has understood wrongly?
lines.literal: mis- means that something goes wrong… so one has understood wrong?

lines.speaker: Elin:
lines.text: Exakt, ett missförstånd. Nu ett svårare: ”ursprung”.
lines.id: Exactly, a misunderstanding. Now a harder one: "ursprung".
lines.literal: exactly, a misunderstanding. now a harder: origin

lines.speaker: Dian:
lines.text: Det som något har sprungit ur? Där något kommer ifrån?
lines.id: What something has sprung out of? Where something comes from?
lines.literal: that which something has sprung out-of? where something comes from?

lines.speaker: Elin:
lines.text: Ja! Och ”ur-” betyder ofta ”den första, den äldsta”, som i urskog och urinvånare.
lines.id: Yes! And "ur-" often means "the first, the oldest", as in old-growth forest and indigenous people.
lines.literal: yes! and ur- means often the first, the oldest, as in primeval-forest and original-inhabitants

lines.speaker: Dian:
lines.text: Då är en urstockholmare någon vars familj alltid har bott här?
lines.id: So an "urstockholmare" is someone whose family has always lived here?
lines.literal: then is an original-Stockholmer someone whose family always has lived here?

lines.speaker: Elin:
lines.text: Precis, som jag. Sista ordet: ”barnslig”.
lines.id: Exactly, like me. Last word: "barnslig".
lines.literal: exactly, like me. last word-the: child-ish

lines.speaker: Dian:
lines.text: Någon som beter sig som ett barn. Men ”barnvänlig” är väl något positivt?
lines.id: Someone who behaves like a child. But "barnvänlig" is something positive, isn't it?
lines.literal: someone who behaves self like a child. but child-friendly is surely something positive?

lines.speaker: Elin:
lines.text: Ja, en barnvänlig restaurang är bra för familjer. Du lär dig snabbt!
lines.id: Yes, a child-friendly restaurant is good for families. You're learning fast!
lines.literal: yes, a child-friendly restaurant is good for families. you learn yourself fast!

lines.speaker: Dian:
lines.text: Jag tror att jag har knäckt koden! Svenska är ju bara Lego.
lines.id: I think I've cracked the code! Swedish is just Lego, really.
lines.literal: I think that I have cracked code-the! Swedish is ju only Lego

notes: **Ohållbar** — the prefix *o-* is Swedish "un-/in-/non-" and it takes the **main stress**: **OO-hohl-bahr**, *OO-möj-lee* (*omöjlig*, impossible), *OO-vahn-lee* (*ovanlig*, unusual). If you stress the root instead, the negative meaning is easy to miss. Careful: not every word starting with *o* is negated — *orsak* (cause) and *ord* (word) have nothing to do with it.

**Missförstånd** — *miss-* ("wrongly, badly") works just like English "mis-": *missförstå* (misunderstand), *missbruk* (abuse), *missnöjd* (dissatisfied), *misslyckas* (to fail). Note the double *s*: *miss* + *förstånd*.

**Ursprung** — *ur* is an old word for "out of" (still alive in *ur* = from inside: *Han tog boken ur väskan*). As a prefix, *ur-* means "original, primeval, the very first": *urskog* (primeval forest), *urinvånare* (indigenous inhabitants), *urpremiär* (world premiere). It can also intensify, colloquially: *urgammal* (ancient), *urtrist* (incredibly boring).
**Vars** — "whose" in a relative clause, from Svenska 102: *någon **vars** familj alltid har bott här*. It is the same for all genders and numbers.

**Barnslig vs barnvänlig** — *-lig* turns a noun into an adjective, often with a negative shade when used of adults: *barnslig* (childish). The compound *-vänlig* ("-friendly") is always positive: *barnvänlig*, *miljövänlig*, *användarvänlig* (user-friendly). Say *barnslig* **BAHNSH-lee**: *rns* becomes "nsh".
**Knäcka koden** — "to crack the code", exactly as in English. *Knäcka* is also "to crack" a nut and, colloquially, a *knäck* is a side job (*extraknäck*) — and a Christmas toffee.

grammars.title: Six prefixes that change meaning
body: Swedish prefixes are few, but each one is productive — they appear in thousands of words. Learn what they do, and an unknown word stops being a black box.

head: Prefix
Meaning
Examples
rows: make more X; do wrongly or too much
förbättra (improve), förenkla (simplify), förkorta (shorten); försova sig (oversleep), förirra sig (get lost)
turns a word into a transitive verb
befria (free, from *fri*), berika (enrich, from *rik*), besvara (answer), bedöma (assess)
ursprung (origin), urskog (old-growth forest), urinvånare (indigenous people), urgammal (ancient)

after: **För-** is the trickiest: the same prefix can mean "make more" (*förstora*, enlarge), "do wrongly" (*förväxla*, confuse two things) or simply mark a formal verb (*förklara*, explain). When in doubt, look at the adjective or verb inside it.

With **be-** and **för-** the prefix is unstressed and the stress falls on the root: *be-SVAH-rah*, *för-BEH-trah*. With **o-**, **miss-**, **sam-** and **ur-** the stress falls on the prefix: *OO-lük-lee*, *MIS-nöyd*, *SAHM-tahl*, *ÜR-skoog*.

dialogs.title: Text — Platsannonsen
dialogs.intro: That same evening Dian finds a job ad that looks as if it had been written for her. Reading it is a word-formation exercise in itself.

lines.speaker: Text:
lines.text: Hållbara Städer AB söker en hållbarhetskonsult till vårt kontor i Stockholm.
lines.id: Hållbara Städer AB is looking for a sustainability consultant for our Stockholm office.
lines.literal: Sustainable Cities Ltd seeks a sustainability-consultant to our office in Stockholm

lines.speaker: Text:
lines.text: Vi är ett snabbväxande konsultbolag som hjälper kommuner och fastighetsägare att minska sin klimatpåverkan.
lines.id: We are a fast-growing consultancy that helps municipalities and property owners reduce their climate impact.
lines.literal: we are a fast-growing consulting-company that helps municipalities and property-owners to reduce their climate-impact

lines.speaker: Text:
lines.text: Som konsult kommer du att arbeta i nära samarbete med våra kunder.
lines.id: As a consultant, you will work in close cooperation with our clients.
lines.literal: as consultant come you to work in close together-work with our customers

lines.speaker: Text:
lines.text: Du har en relevant akademisk examen och goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.
lines.id: You have a relevant university degree and a good command of Swedish and English.
lines.literal: you have a relevant academic degree and good knowledges in Swedish and English

lines.speaker: Text:
lines.text: Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av stadsplanering eller miljöfrågor.
lines.id: Experience in urban planning or environmental issues is a plus.
lines.literal: we see gladly that you have experience of city-planning or environment-questions

lines.speaker: Text:
lines.text: Som person är du nyfiken, ansvarstagande och samarbetsvillig.
lines.id: As a person, you are curious, responsible and a team player.
lines.literal: as person are you new-eager, responsibility-taking and cooperation-willing

lines.speaker: Text:
lines.text: Du trivs med självständigt arbete men uppskattar också gemenskapen i ett litet team.
lines.id: You enjoy working independently but also appreciate the community of a small team.
lines.literal: you thrive with self-standing work but appreciate also community-the in a little team

lines.speaker: Text:
lines.text: Ofullständiga ansökningar kommer inte att behandlas.
lines.id: Incomplete applications will not be considered.
lines.literal: un-complete applications come not to be-handled

lines.speaker: Text:
lines.text: Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning.
lines.id: The position is permanent, with a six-month probationary period.
lines.literal: position-the is an until-further-employment with six months' trial-employment

lines.speaker: Text:
lines.text: Urvalet sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan!
lines.id: We review applications on a rolling basis, so don't wait to apply!
lines.literal: selection-the happens running, so wait not with your application!

notes: **Snabbväxande** — *snabb* + *växande* (present participle of *växa*, to grow): "fast-growing". Swedish builds compound adjectives from participles as freely as English does: *långtgående* (far-reaching), *nyutexaminerad* (newly graduated).

**Klimatpåverkan** — *klimat* + *påverkan* (influence, impact). *Påverkan* itself comes from the verb *påverka* — a noun in *-an*, a small but useful group: *påverkan*, *samverkan*, *början*, *längtan*.

**Vi ser gärna att du har…** — the classic job-ad formula for "it's a plus if you have…". Its sister is *Det är meriterande om du har…* ("it counts in your favor if…"). Requirements, in contrast, are introduced with *Du har…* or *Vi kräver…*

**Ansvarstagande och samarbetsvillig** — two compound adjectives at the heart of Swedish work culture: *ansvar* + *tagande* ("responsibility-taking"), *samarbete* + *villig* ("willing to cooperate"). The *-s-* in between is the binding *s* from Svenska 103: *ansvar**s**tagande*, *samarbet**s**villig*.
**Ofullständiga** — *o-* + *fullständig* (complete): "incomplete". The *o-* prefix even works on long words: *oförutsägbar* (unpredictable), *oundviklig* (inevitable).

**En tillsvidareanställning** — literally "an until-further-notice employment": a permanent contract. It is usually preceded by *provanställning* (probation, max six months). The opposite is *visstidsanställning* (fixed-term contract). **Urvalet sker löpande** — applications are reviewed as they come in, so the job may be gone before the deadline.

grammars.title: Suffixes that make nouns and adjectives
body: Suffixes tell you the **word class** — and with nouns, usually the **gender** too. Once you know them, you can read a word you have never seen and still know how to use it in a sentence.

head: Suffix
Makes
Meaning
Examples
rows: en tydlighet, en hållbarhet, en enkelhet
en vänskap, en kunskap, ett ledarskap, ett landskap
en barndom, en ungdom, en sjukdom, en rikedom

after: **-skap** wavers between genders: *en vänskap*, *en kunskap*, but *ett landskap*, *ett sällskap*, *ett ledarskap*. Check the dictionary for each one.

**-lig** and **-ig** are pronounced the same in speech: the *g* is silent (*begriplig* → **beh-GREEP-lee**, *självständig* → **HWELV-sten-dee**). In the neuter, the *-t* comes back: *begripligt*, *självständigt*.

blocks.text: At B2 you will meet many words a day that you have never seen before, and most of them are built from parts you already know. Before you reach for a dictionary, try this method — it works on almost every long Swedish word.

items: **Peel off the prefix**: *o-*, *miss-*, *för-*, *be-*, *sam-*, *ur-*.
**Peel off the suffix** — it tells you the word class and often the gender.
**Split compounds from the end**: the last part is the main word, the rest describe it. Look for the binding *-s-*.
**Find the root** and ask what it means in the context of the sentence.
**Check the guess** against the context. If the sentence still makes sense, you are probably right.

head: Word
Parts
Meaning
rows: sam + häll + s + om + vandl + ing
ur + sprung + s + be + folk + ning

blocks.title: When the parts lie
items: Some words have drifted so far that the parts no longer help: *ursäkt* (excuse, apology) has nothing to do with "original".
*Förlåt* (sorry) is not "let wrongly", and *förstå* (understand) is not "stand wrongly".
So: guess from the parts, but always confirm in context.

blocks.text: Swedish job ads (*platsannonser*) follow a predictable pattern: who we are, what you will do, who you are, practical information. The vocabulary is just as predictable.

head: Svenska
Pronunciation
English
rows: an advantage, a plus (in a job ad)

blocks.title: Spiral review — back to Svenska 103, Unit 17
items: There you learned the binding *-s-* in compounds: *arbets|miljö|verket*.
Find every binding *-s-* in today's job ad: *hållbarhet**s**konsult*, *fastighet**s**ägare*, *ansvar**s**tagande*, *samarbet**s**villig*.
Rule of thumb: after *-het*, *-ning*, *-skap* and *-tion*, a binding *-s-* is almost always used.

exercises.title: Translation
items: The situation is unsustainable.
What is the origin of the word?
I had a happy childhood.
This restaurant is very child-friendly.
The position is permanent, with a six-month probationary period.
Don't wait to send your application!

answers: o — miss — sam — för — be — ur
Det är en ohållbar situation. — Det var bara ett missförstånd. — Ofullständiga ansökningar kommer inte att behandlas. — Urvalet sker löpande. — Jag trivs med självständigt arbete.

Situationen är ohållbar. — Vad är ordets ursprung? — Jag hade en lycklig barndom. — Den här restaurangen är väldigt barnvänlig. — Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning. — Vänta inte med att skicka din ansökan!
